name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Set a 3px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 1px white stroke at 50% opacity for keyboard focus. This keeps the ring visible against dark backgrounds while staying lightweight on battery-limited mobile devices. The trade-off is slightly thicker rings on high-DPI screens, but the clarity for low-vision keyboard users outweighs the minor visual bulk.

name: Reader
text: The 3px ring with a 1px white stroke at 50% opacity may still blend into dark backgrounds, especially for users with certain visual impairments. A better alternative could be a 2px ring with a 1px white stroke at 70% opacity, as it provides a better balance between visibility and subtlety. To settle the argument, we need to test these options with real users, especially those with low-vision, to determine which one provides the best accessibility without compromising the overall design.

name: Ramp
text:
Keep the 3px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 1px white stroke at 50% opacity. It meets WCAG 2.2 AA for contrast on dark backgrounds while remaining thin enough for mobile battery life. The white stroke at 50% opacity ensures visibility for low-vision users without creating glare. Trade-off: on very dark screens, the ring may still fade slightly, but this is preferable to a thicker ring that drains batteries faster.

name: Reader
text: The 3px ring risks failing WCAG 2.2 AA on dark backgrounds for users with low vision or color blindness. A 2px ring with a 1px white stroke at 70% opacity passes contrast checks while staying battery-friendly. Settle with a live contrast test against WCAG 2.2 AA guidelines on both light and dark themes.
